description: Prepare dropping a pool from the mandate of an LP vault this wallet curates: it funds no new loan there from then on; loans already open run to their ends. A wallet the LP registry lets open one (a curator it allows, or anyone once it opens vault creation) opens a vault through the lane's factory and curates it: it funds loans only in the pools of its mandate, a pool added funding three hours later and one dropped stopping at once (open loans run on); the curator never touches its lenders' money. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

pool.description: The pool, as gage_capabilities lpLane.pools names it under that adapter

vault.description: An LP vault this wallet curates (gage_lp_vaults curator)

name: gage_prepare_lp_vault_remove_pool
title: Prepare: Drop a pool from an LP vault
